words.example: All clear on the new roster?
We need clarification on the date.
words.exampleZh: 我们需要把日期澄清一下。

words.meaning: 全量区域传送（Authoritative Zone Transfer）
words.example: Last night's AXFR (Authoritative Zone Transfer) copied every record to the spare server.
words.exampleZh: 昨晚的 AXFR（全量区域传送）把全部记录复制到了备用服务器。

words.meaning: 增量区域传送（Incremental Zone Transfer）
words.example: The IXFR (Incremental Zone Transfer) sent only the records changed since Tuesday.
words.exampleZh: IXFR（增量区域传送）只发送了周二以来变更过的记录。

words.example: DNS notify told the secondary server that the zone had changed.
words.exampleZh: 区域变更通知告诉辅助服务器，该区域已经变了。

words.example: TSIG (Transaction Signature) signs each transfer so a stranger cannot alter it.
words.exampleZh: TSIG（事务签名）给每次传送签名，防止外人篡改。

words.meaning: 域名安全扩展（Domain Name System Security Extensions）
words.example: DNSSEC (Domain Name System Security Extensions) proves our hospital domain records are genuine.
words.exampleZh: DNSSEC（域名安全扩展）用来证明本院域名记录是真实的。
